legend: This tumour shows areas of high-grade transformation (dedifferentiation) with loss of the biphasic pattern.
The areas of high-grade transformation (dedifferentiation) show solid areas with loss of the biphasic pattern, increased pleomorphism, and mitoses.
p63 immunohistochemistry highlights the outer layer of myoepithelial cells, demonstrating the biphasic pattern.
